app.name: Expense Tracker
home.empty: Nothing recorded yet. Tap + to add your first expense.
home.averageIs: The dashed line is your average, {{amount}} a day.
add.title: Add expense
history.title: History
budget.title: Budget
budget.pace: {{elapsed}}% of the month gone, {{spent}}% of the budget spent
more.title: More
txn.title: Transaction
txn.deleteBody: It will be removed from your totals. You can add it again if this was a mistake.
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Add one to start recording.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.currencyLocked: Currency can't change once an account has transactions — it would reinterpret every amount already recorded.
categories.name: Name
categories.hideBody: Transactions already filed under it keep it, so your history stays complete. It just won't appear when adding.
more.categoriesHint: Add your own, hide the ones you don't use
more.languageHint: Changing the language takes effect on the next screen you open.
more.currencyHint: Reports roll up into this currency.
more.privacy: All your data stays on this phone. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
budget.noCategories: No category spending this month yet.
reports.title: Reports
reports.dashedIsAverage: The dashed line is your daily average.
more.reportsHint: Where the money went, month by month
inbox.title: Waiting for you
inbox.lead: {{count}} recorded automatically. Confirm what's right, reject what isn't.
inbox.empty: Nothing waiting. Anything the app records for you appears here first.
rules.empty: No rules yet. The app still learns from every correction you make.
rules.lead: A rule files a transaction the moment it appears. Rules win over what the app has learned, so use them for the things you never want it to get wrong.
rules.badRegex: That pattern isn't valid, so this rule would never match.
recurring.empty: Nothing repeating yet. Add rent, an EMI or a subscription.
recurring.lead: Things that happen whether you record them or not. The app records them for you.
recurring.autoPostHint: Off means it waits in your inbox for a tap — better for anything whose amount changes.
more.backupHint: Export to a spreadsheet, or move to a new phone
more.appLockUnavailable: No fingerprint or screen lock set up on this phone
more.appLockCaveat: This hides the app. It does not encrypt the data on your phone — that comes with cloud sync later.
lock.locked: Unlock with your fingerprint or screen lock to see your spending.
backup.csvHint: A CSV of every transaction, ready to open in Excel or Google Sheets. Good for reading and totalling; it cannot restore your budgets, rules or categories.
backup.csvShared: Exported. Choose where to keep it.
backup.backupHint: One file containing everything — transactions, accounts, categories, budgets, rules and repeats. Keep it somewhere safe; it is the only way to move your history.
backup.backupShared: Backup saved. Choose where to keep it.
backup.restoreWarning: Restoring replaces everything currently in the app.
backup.restoreBody: This deletes the {{rows}} records on this phone and puts the backup in their place. It cannot be undone.
backup.imported: Imported {{imported}}. Skipped {{skipped}} that had no usable amount.
backup.shareFailed: Could not open the share sheet.
backup.error.notJson: That file isn't readable as a backup.
backup.error.notOurs: That isn't a backup from this app.
backup.error.tooNew: That backup was made by a newer version of the app. Update first, then restore.
backup.dbHint: The same data as the database file the app actually uses. Two formats that can fail in different ways — if one ever refuses to open, try the other.
backup.dbShared: Database file saved. Choose where to keep it.
backup.autoHint: When this is on, a backup is written inside the app every {{days}} days and the last {{keep}} are kept. Android's own backup carries them to a new phone. They go away if you uninstall the app — so still save one somewhere you choose.
backup.autoOnMessage: Automatic backups are on. One has been taken now.
backup.autoOffMessage: Automatic backups are off. The ones already taken are kept.
backup.snapshotSize: {{kb}} KB. What would you like to do with it?
scan.title: Scan a bill
scan.lead: Photograph a bill and the amount is filled in for you.
scan.privacy: The photo is read on this phone and stays on this phone. Nothing is uploaded.
scan.foundTotal: Taken from the line marked TOTAL. Change it if that's wrong.
scan.foundGuess: Nothing said TOTAL, so this is the largest number on the bill. Check it.
scan.couldNotRead: Nothing readable on this photo. The bill is saved — type the amount yourself. Bright, flat, filling the frame reads best.
scan.needsRebuild: The app on this phone was built before scanning was added, so the camera and the reader are not in it. Rebuild it: npx expo prebuild --platform android, then npx expo run:android. Reloading the JavaScript is not enough.
scan.noPermission: The app needs permission to use the camera or your photos. You can grant it in Android Settings.
scan.discardBody: The photo and everything read from it will be deleted.
txn.removeReceiptBody: The transaction is kept. Only the photo is deleted, and it cannot be undone.
backup.zipHint: One ZIP with everything, including your bill photos. This is the one to keep.
backup.zipHintWithReceipts: One ZIP with everything, including your {{receipts}} bill photos. This is the one to keep.
backup.zipShared: Backup saved, with {{receipts}} photos. Choose where to keep it.
backup.jsonHint: Or just the data, with no photos — smaller, and readable in any text editor.
backup.error.notZip: That file isn't a backup ZIP from this app.
scan.readNothing: The reader ran but found no text on this image.
